component_benchmark: CNC-Machined Automotive Differential Housing / Steering Knuckle Bore (AlSi9Cu3 & SG Iron)

references.visual_signature: Uniform isotropic tool lay (Ra <= 1.2 um), crisp chamfer edge
Clean M12 tapped thread crests, zero tear-out on exit hole
Matte silver-grey metallic reflectance under cross-polarized light
references.root_cause_correlation: Optimal cutting temperature & flood coolant flow

references.visual_signature: Periodic wave/fish-scale witness marks (0.4-1.2 mm pitch) inside bore
references.root_cause_correlation: Phase-locked 4.2 kHz AE harmonic + CT current ripple

references.visual_signature: Attached plastically deformed metal lip (>0.15 mm) on milled edge
references.root_cause_correlation: Severe flank wear on cutting insert + high Z-axis thrust load

references.visual_signature: Single deep linear score line or raised ridge across sealing face
references.root_cause_correlation: Sudden high-frequency AE burst (>12 kHz) mid-cut

references.visual_signature: Straw-yellow to bluish oxide tint on machined steel/iron surface
references.root_cause_correlation: Coolant nozzle blockage or excessive cutting speed (Vc)

references.visual_signature: Micro-craters and welded aluminum/iron fragments smeared on path
references.root_cause_correlation: Low cutting speed causing material adhesion on tool tip

references.category: True Defect — Feed Dwell Witness Line
references.visual_signature: Single vertical axial step mark where tool paused while engaged
references.root_cause_correlation: Mid-pass feed hold or servo drive micro-stutter

references.visual_signature: Clustered dark pinholes (0.3-2.0 mm) exposed after face milling
references.root_cause_correlation: Upstream foundry gas entrapment (Zero CNC chatter!)

references.visual_signature: Irregular non-metallic dark pocket with trailing tool scratch
references.root_cause_correlation: Upstream casting defect causing sudden insert fracture

references.visual_signature: Translucent fluid bead with smooth meniscus (if air-knife missed)
references.root_cause_correlation: Incomplete air blow-off; zero acoustic anomaly during cut

references.visual_signature: Unattached curly metal chip resting on surface
references.root_cause_correlation: Chip conveyor carry-over; blows off with secondary puff

references.visual_signature: Dark matte streak on nodular cast iron with zero topological depth
references.root_cause_correlation: Normal free-graphite lubrication smear on SG iron
